# Pediatric Dental Care of Fairfax

> > Comprehensive pediatric dental care for children in Northern Virginia with specialized services, multiple locations, and a team of experienced pediatric dentists.

Pediatric Dental Care of Fairfax provides specialized dental services for children across three Northern Virginia locations (Fairfax, Springfield, and Chantilly) under the leadership of Dr. John Han and his team. The practice emphasizes gentle, compassionate care with advanced treatment options including sedation dentistry and preventive oral health education.

## Dental Services

- [Childrens dentistry | Fairfax, Virginia | PEDIATRIC DENTAL CARE](https://www.mypdcdentists.com/childrens-dentistry): Overview of comprehensive children's dentistry services in Fairfax
- [pediatric dentistry | John Han | Fairfax, Virginia](https://www.mypdcdentists.com/pediatric-dentistry): Specialized pediatric dentistry services emphasizing gentle, compassionate care
- [Routine Exams and Treatments | Kids Pediatric Dentist In Fairfax, VA | Pediatric Dental Care Of Fairfax](https://www.mypdcdentists.com/routine-exams-and-treatments): Routine dental exams, cleanings, and fluoride treatments for children
- [Kids Cavity Dentist In Fairfax, VA | Pediatric Dental Care](https://www.mypdcdentists.com/kids-cavity-in-fairfax-va): Cavity treatment options including composite resin and inlays/onlays
- [Sedation Dentistry Fairfax, VA | Pediatric Dental Care](https://www.mypdcdentists.com/sedation-dentistry): Sedation options including nitrous oxide for anxious children
- [Kids Tooth Extraction | Kids Pediatric Dentist In Fairfax, VA | Pediatric Dental Care Of Fairfax](https://www.mypdcdentists.com/kids-tooth-extraction): Tooth extraction procedures for children with orthodontic preparation
